expectations.text: Uses `kde start staging` or `kde create staging` to create the environment
Uses `kind` as the environment type (explicitly or by default)
Uses `kde proj create api-service` to create the project
expectations.evidence: Skips `kde project create` and goes straight to `kde project fetch`. Notes fetch does not create project.env but does not suggest create first.

expectations.text: Uses `kde proj fetch api-service` with the correct git URL and branch
Uses `kde proj deploy api-service` or `kde proj pipeline api-service` to deploy
Does NOT fabricate non-existent kde commands or flags
expectations.evidence: All commands match actual kde command syntax
